required_inputs: publisher-authenticated sensor coordinates in the same frame
declared elevation axis and coordinate units
release start and stop or a publisher-authenticated time crosswalk
release orientation and ventilation state for prespecified subgroup reporting
future_holdout.case_selection: include every case in the frozen dataset scope that satisfies the required inputs; do not exclude a case after viewing response metrics
future_holdout.response_definition: q99 minus q10 hydrogen concentration during the publisher-authenticated release/evaluation interval
future_holdout.invalid_case_policy: retain and report all failures; a format-only amendment may repair parsing but may not change the candidate, thresholds, response definition, or case scope

decision_rule.failure_effect: retain the result as a negative holdout; do not enable runtime routing or change alarm thresholds
decision_rule.pass_effect: supports only spatial rank transfer for the tested domain; runtime promotion still requires an explicit safety review and regression test

claim_boundary: This freeze does not validate detector placement, hydrogen concentration, alarm time, flammable volume, ESD performance, CFD, outdoor HRS dispersion, or any site safety distance. A dataset-specific protocol must identify and hash a new untouched cohort before numerical outcomes are accessed.
